info.title: Project Brief Agent API
info.description: Project Brief v0.9.8. Existing assigned-task endpoints retain their scopes and assignment boundaries. Additional reads require explicit registration permission and matching new token scope, plus owner grant, membership and parent-object access. New agent output is internal to the project team; historical visibility is unchanged.

get.description: Required scope: agent:profile. Also requires active owner grant, project membership and assignment (except profile). No task workflow/approval changes.

200.description: Success; no-store. Replayed writes include Idempotency-Replayed: true.

401.description: Invalid, expired, revoked or disabled credential

409.description: Idempotency conflict or stale assignment generation
